title: Docker
description: How Clank uses Docker: which container platform, how often it is checked, and how long it may take.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

adapter.description: The adapter Clank uses for containers: auto (Docker Desktop on Windows and macOS; on Linux, the one of the engine the docker command would use, chosen without waking any: Docker's view says which and why), docker-desktop, or docker-engine (Docker Engine on Linux, the system's service, which Clank never starts or stops).
adapter.title: Container platform

poll_seconds.description: How often, in seconds, Clank reads Docker's state.
poll_seconds.title: Checked every

allow_unlimited_memory.description: Open workspaces even where Docker cannot limit a container's memory (a Raspberry Pi's default kernel): an agent's runaway process could then take this computer's memory. Off: no workspace opens there, saying how to turn the limits on.
allow_unlimited_memory.title: Allow unlimited memory

start_timeout_seconds.description: How long a start may take before it is reported as failed.
start_timeout_seconds.title: Time to start

stop_timeout_seconds.description: How long a stop may take before it is reported as failed.
stop_timeout_seconds.title: Time to stop

question_minutes.description: How long a question about stopping Docker waits before its default (cancel) applies.
question_minutes.title: Time to answer
